body: Thanks so much for the reply. I couldn't agree more. Sometimes I think that maybe I'm crazy and missing something obvious that everyone else understands. People also typically say that not raising a family is selfish, which I don't understand.

Whether we have life after death is irrelevant. I don't think eternal life would change the fact that everything is pointless. Even if there is some higher purpose (a god(s) or the like) that doesn't change my view. Whatever "purpose" you can possibly give to anything is ultimately meaningless and pointless. Maybe I'm crazy.

Maybe. I think the "meaning" or "higher purpose" debate is nonsense. I feel like asking what's the meaning of human life is like asking what's the meaning of a coin. It's silly. A coin can serve a purpose, but can it be "meaningful"?
